senses.gloss: f. (סרי) offal, garbage, offensive matter; stench.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:16">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite> <he>מקום ס׳</he> a place where garbage is deposited.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:4">Gen. R. s. 28</cite> <he>ומלאו … ס׳</he> they filled the whole city with stench.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:4">Ib.</cite> s. 63 <he>ותצא סֵרְיוּתוֹ עמו</he> (not <cite ref="O01615"><he>סרייתו</he></cite>) let the offensive matter (surrounding the embryo) go out with him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 110:2">Yalk. ib. 110</cite>. Pesik. B’shall. p. 81ᵇ; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 225:12">Yalk. Ex. 225</cite> <cite ref="O01310"><he>סֵי׳</he></cite> putrid fish.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 42:8">Ex. R. s. 42</cite> (ref. to <he>סָרוּ</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 32:8">Ex. XXXII, 8</cite>, cmp. <cite ref="O01595"><he>סָרָה</he></cite> a. <cite ref="O00833"><he>סִירָה</he> I</cite>) <he>נעשו ס׳ נעשו כובים</he> (not <he>כזבים</he>) they have become refuse, they have become thorns. Y. Kidd. III, end, 65ᵃ <he>מוליכין … וס׳ אצל ס׳</he> mud is carried to mud, and refuse to refuse (v. <cite ref="I00390"><he>טִינָּא</he></cite>, a. correct quot. s. v.).—V. <cite ref="O00833"><he>סִירָה</he> I</cite>, 2.
